entities.summary: Lenka Pichlíková – Burke is a Czech-American actress. She is the seventh generation of her family to appear onstage since the 18th century, her great-uncle was the noted national actor, Ladislav Pešek. While in Czechoslovakia, she performed on stage in many theatres, played in twelve films, and created over 40 television roles, rising to the rank of Advanced Master Artist. In addition to performing as a speaking actress, she was also involved professionally in classic pantomime. Since the 1980s she has resided in the United States.

entities.summary: Lenka Pichlíková – Burke is a Czech-American actress. She is the seventh generation of her family to appear onstage since the 18th century, her great-uncle was the noted national actor, Ladislav Pešek. While in Czechoslovakia, she performed on stage in many theatres, played in twelve films, and created over 40 television roles, rising to the rank of Advanced Master Artist. In addition to performing as a speaking actress, she was also involved professionally in classic pantomime. Since the 1980s she has resided in the United States.
